messages.content: Draft an email response to a customer asking about account password reset

Dear Customer,

Thank you for reaching out regarding your account password reset. I understand how essential it is to have access to your account. To assist you with this, please follow the steps below to reset your password:

1. Go to the VibeTeam login page.
2. Click on the ‘Forgot Password?’ link.
3. Enter your registered email address.
4. You will receive an email with instructions to reset your password.

If you encounter any issues during this process or if you don't receive the reset email, please let me know, and I will be happy to assist you further.

Thank you for your patience.

Best Regards,  
Grace  
Support Engineer  
VibeTeam
